aliases: The store-level `aliases` object is hand-maintained and preserved by collectors (they rewrite only their own channel section); planning consumes it to merge cross-channel spellings.
description: Channel-declared facts parsed from the OpenCode go.mdx document into the opencode-go section of the shared models_extra store. go.mdx owns the model list (ADR 0011); public card data is filled at planning time from data/all_models.json, never here.

channels.opencode-go.<id>.note: Keys are exactly the go.mdx model ids; an id that leaves the document leaves the section. Channel-provided claude-* models are not collected (ADR 0012). Speed-marketing variants (-fast/-highspeed) are stamped exclude=speed-variant so planning skips them. Free models keep the parser's zero prices; blank free quotas are backfilled by the parser and re-derived at planning time from the model's owning channel.

name.consumer: plan name fallback when all_models.json has no card for the id

exclude.consumer: planning skips the record and reports collector_excluded

rp5h.consumer: model-registry models_mapping.py candidate scoring (log-normalized RP5H component) and remark

cost.source_columns: Input / Output / Cached Read / Cached Write
cost.type: object {input, output, cache_read, cache_write} of number|null
cost.note: channel price wins over models.dev in the plan; known drift: glm-5.3-flash is 2x in models.dev (2x-usage billing variant), minimax-m2.5 cache_read is 2x in models.dev, and models.dev omits cache_write for most Go models

context_threshold.derived: context-length variant condition on the pricing-table model name

peak_hours.derived: peak/off-peak variant condition plus the document's peak-hours sentence

not_collected.note: Parsed by scripts/parse_opencode_mdx.py but dropped here.

write_rule: Read-modify-write via watch-pipeline/scripts/models_extra.py: only channels.opencode-go is rewritten. Writers must serialize (CI orders the goat job after this job).
